findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "test_conversion" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: test_conversion, get_conversion_report · Private data: test_conversion · Public sink: get_conversion_report · Destructive: test_conversion, get_conversion_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: test_conversion, get_conversion_report · Private data: test_conversion · Public sink: get_conversion_report · Destructive: test_conversion, get_conversion_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
